description: Starlink terminal takes ~15 minutes to reacquire signal after being disconnected and repositioned — discovered mid-EVA during a planned field comms test.
response: The EVA team waited; Starlink eventually connected and real-time comms were successfully demonstrated.
lesson: Power up Starlink at least 20 minutes before any EVA that relies on real-time hab-field comms. For departure winterisation: disconnect Starlink last, after Mission Support has been notified.
source_citation: SRC-hypatia-iii-brief, Part IV – Incident and emergency register, §4.3 Operational incidents, lines 638-643. Register Crew tag: 'C16'. Sol: not stated; 'discovered mid-EVA during a planned field comms test' placed at a representative mid-mission point. Confidence (B) rationale: EVA-narrative account of a comms delay; daily-report style. system_category note: Starlink is the hab's field-comms system supporting EVA communication; mapped to EVA Suits & Comms rather than Logistics or Operational/Process since the impact is specifically on hab-to-field EVA comms. Reclassification note (2026-08-26): originally classified Failure; on review, nothing malfunctioned — a 15-minute reacquisition delay is an inherent Starlink terminal characteristic, discovered during a test and worked around by waiting. This is better described as an Observation about system behaviour than a failure.
